Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost for a trip around North America?

Right now the cheapest 4-city North America trip we can build from live one-way fares is about $328 in flights. It changes daily as fares move &mdash; this page refreshes with the current low.

What's the cheapest way to travel around North America?

Fly one-way between cities instead of booking separate round-trips. Chaining cheap one-ways into a loop is almost always cheaper, and it's exactly what this tool finds.

Can I build my own North America trip?

Yes &mdash; use the interactive builder to set the number of cities, your budget, and a must-visit city, then share your route.
